Pass a plain source string to Content through code. Use lineNumbers to show line numbers, or pass an array of highlighted tokens to Line.code when you already have token data.

## Usage

```ts
import { codeBlock, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/code-block';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/code-block`. It [registers](../../registration/) 8 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.CodeBlockLineToken`, `components.CodeBlockLineVariant`, `components.CodeBlockSize`, `components.CodeBlockVariant`.

- `components.codeBlockLineVariants` takes options `variant` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.

- `components.codeBlockVariants` takes options `variant` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
